name: Tabs
summary: Labelled horizontal tab set with paired panels, one selected item, roving focus, automatic or manual activation, disabled items, and target-owned controlled or uncontrolled selection.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Wrapper that coordinates one selected tab and one visible panel.

anatomy.name: tab
anatomy.description: Repeatable native Button with tab role, selection state, and panel relationship.

anatomy.name: panel
anatomy.description: Repeatable panel paired with one tab and hidden when inactive.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover emphasis on an enabled tab without changing selection.

states.name: selected
states.description: Exactly one selected tab whose panel is visible.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus remains distinct from selected state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable tab is skipped by selection and roving navigation.

states.name: panelHidden
states.description: Inactive panel is removed from rendering and sequential focus.

behavior.name: tabSemantics
behavior.description: A labelled tablist contains linked tabs whose paired panels reference them in return.

behavior.name: rovingFocus
behavior.description: One enabled tab participates in sequential focus; horizontal navigation wraps among enabled tabs and respects rendered direction.

behavior.name: activation
behavior.description: Automatic mode selects on focus when panels are preloaded; manual mode selects only on click, Enter, or Space.

behavior.name: panelVisibility
behavior.description: Exactly one selected tab and associated panel are active; every inactive panel uses native hidden.

behavior.name: panelFocus
behavior.description: When panel content has no appropriate first focus target, the panel enters the Tab sequence.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
behavior.description: Targets may manage selection through controlled value or uncontrolled default value, but must emit one change equivalent and keep item states synchronized.

behavior.name: unsupportedModes
behavior.description: Vertical, closable, reorderable, routed, lazy, and responsive Accordion modes are not v1 behavior.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name that identifies the purpose of the complete tablist.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more paired native tab Button and panel compositions.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Marks an individual tab as selected; the containing set must keep exactly one enabled tab and panel active.

properties.name: activationMode
properties.description: Determines whether moving focus selects immediately or waits for explicit activation.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes an individual tab unavailable and removes it from roving selection.

accessibility: Provide an accessible name for the tablist and link every tab and panel pair in both directions.
Keep exactly one enabled tab selected and one panel visible; inactive panels use native hidden.
Implement roving tabindex with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, and End while skipping disabled tabs.
Use automatic activation only when panel content is preloaded and appears without noticeable latency; otherwise use manual activation.
Include text-only panels in sequential focus when they do not begin with an appropriate focusable element.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns horizontal presentation; the consuming target owns roving focus, selection, ids, and change events.

shopify.notes: Map to Shopify host Tabs value/defaultValue/change/controls/id when available; theme targets implement the neutral behavior.
